definitions.full: H5504. sachar [ סַ֫חַר ] noun masculine Prov 3:14 traffic, gain ; — construct סְחַר Isa 23:3 2 t.; suffix סַחְרָהּ Prov 3:14 3 t.; — traffic , i.e. gain from traffic, Isa 23:3 , 18 (+ אֶתְנַנָּהּ ), 23:18 ; 45:14 ; Prov 3:14 ; 31:18 .
